darkness.description: Creates portal connecting two locations that the spellcaster can manifest in its mind.
darkness.name: Dark Gate

earth.description: Spellcaster can reshape matter depending on focus, imagination and energy input.
earth.name: Natural Engineering

fire.description: Energy gets converted to a bundled mass of fire able to send flying until it impacts.
fire.name: Fireball

light.description: Every source of light can be converted to energy for the spellcaster to use.
light.name: Heavens Authority

water.description: Spellbound subject can breath under water.
water.name: Poseidons Grace

water.description: Trap subject/object in rotating sphere of water while maintaining breathable inner void.
water.name: Rotary Cage

mental.description: Enhance reflexes and boost brain output.
mental.name: Focus Boost

physical.description: Spellcaster can heal structural damage and replenish energy of subject/object.
physical.name: Heal

physical.description: Energy is constantly converted to regenerate spellcasters cells and heal status effects to a certain degree.
physical.name: Autonomous Regeneration

physical.description: Improve nervous system, bone density and muscle quality by converting large quantity of energy.
physical.name: Power Enhancement

objective.description: Spellbound object or subject appears in different looks to each viewer.
objective.name: Anonymity

subjective.description: Spellbound subject sees demons randomly appear as fearsome figures, fed and powered by their one energy.
subjective.name: Demon Watch
